product_overview: Swjsh Algo Knife is an autonomous intelligence trading terminal and agent deployment hub designed for emotionless, algorithmic trade execution in Forex, Crypto, and Index markets. It combines engineered precision with a premium SaaS template aesthetic to provide professional-grade market monitoring, trade execution, and risk management through AI-driven trading agents.
core_goals: Enable emotionless and high-performance trade execution across multiple asset classes (Forex, Crypto, Indices).
Provide autonomous, agent-based activity with sophisticated trading strategies and performance grading.
Ensure secure user authentication and multi-tenancy for personalized strategy management and trade history tracking.
Offer a dynamic SaaS-style dashboard with dual theme support and real-time market data visualization.
Deliver robust risk management including global and per-agent trade limits, market regime detection, and emergency kill switches.
Maintain high data integrity and seamless synchronization between backend trade logs and UI representations.
key_features: Firebase Authentication supporting Google Sign-In and Secure Email/Password login.
Custom dashboard with particle-based hero landing, sidebar/header navigation, and a mega-menu for strategy and agent selection.
Dual theme system: Voltrex Protocol (dark) and Nature/Café Precision (light) with specialized color schemes and animations.
Trading engine supporting live data from Yahoo Finance, Binance, and Finnhub with webhook-based signal ingestion from TradingView.
Autonomous trading agents including Pivot Pete, Boba, SPX Sniper, The Professor, and The Auditor with specialized roles.
Centralized trade journaling with CRUD APIs and validation to maintain a persistent state of trades and agent performance.
Risk management suite including RiskEngine for trade limits and correlation filters, FrictionSimulator for slippage/latency, RegimeDetector for market states, and KillSwitch for emergency halts.
Continuous market ticker displaying BTC, ETH, SPX, and major FX pairs in real-time.
user_flow_summary: User lands on a particle-animated hero page and clicks 'CONNECT TERMINAL'.
User authenticates via Google or email/password through Firebase Auth.
Upon successful login, user is redirected to the Command Center dashboard with access to strategy selection and agent profiles.
TradingView webhook sends trading signals, which are validated by the agent runner and risk engine.
RegimeDetector verifies the market condition suitability before executing trades.
Trades execute autonomously applying realistic slippage and latency via FrictionSimulator.
The Professor grades completed trades; The Auditor verifies grades and updates the journal.
Users can manage agents, view journal entries, and trigger/reset KillSwitches via dashboard APIs.
validation_criteria: All dashboard routes are protected and do not expose content without authentication.
Theme context switching applies consistently with no styling or variable breakage.
Trade journal data in the database perfectly matches the UI trade representation 1:1.
Trading signals from the webhook are authenticated, validated, and processed correctly with proper error handling.
KillSwitch API triggers and resets work reliably, halting and resuming trade execution appropriately.
Agent lifecycle management APIs support creating, retrieving, and performance tracking of autonomous agents.
Performance metrics show zero lag in CSS and animation transitions under typical user load.
Comprehensive error responses and validation ensure robust API endpoint reliability and data integrity.
